newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies nine muni bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies nine muni bond issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Carroll Community School District, Iowa, $2 million school bonds.
--North Muskegon Public School District, Mich., $8.2 million GOs.
--Rosemount Independent School District No 196, Minn., $10.692 million GOs.
--Minot, N.D., $2.58 million refunding and improvement bonds.
--Berlin Brothers School District, Pa., $4.1 million GOs.
--Montgomery Area School District, Pa., $3.96 million GOs.
